title: REQ · Effect context tests call createPhaserEffectContext with both arguments
summary: bootSceneEffects calls the two-argument factory with a typed resolveKey
description: Context: createPhaserEffectContext(scene, resolveKey) requires two arguments but bootSceneEffects.test.ts calls it with one at lines 114 and 123. Desired behavior: the factory exposes a named ResolveKey type and tests pass a typed mock. Expected result: no TS2554 in that file. Why: clears the unmet check.
acceptance_criteria: Given effectContext.ts, when imported, then it exports a ResolveKey type equal to (id: string) => string
Given the effects tests, when run, then each call passes a typed resolveKey mock and all pass

preserve: createEffect behavior for dust and ambientLight
